Build kit for "date picker"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Top Nav
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        course-detail
package:     @astryxdesign/core
displayName: Course Detail
description: Long-form sales page for a single offering, in two columns - read the pitch, then enroll from a sticky rail. The main column holds a preview poster with a fact row, an about block with skill chips, a module syllabus whose sections collapse module by module, an instructor card, reviews with a scored-aspects panel, and a FAQ; the rail holds the price, a self-paced or cohort start picker, and a weekly-pace slider that computes a finish date. The shape for any offering with a curriculum and a purchase panel - a course, class, masterclass, bootcamp, workshop, or training.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template course-detail --type page <path>

name:        Calendar
package:     @astryxdesign/core

name:        DateInput
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       190
reason:      keyword "datepicker"
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DateInput
description: DateInput lets the user type or pick a date from a calendar popover. Use it for scheduling, deadlines, booking dates, or any form field that needs a specific calendar date.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component DateInput

name:        DateTimeInput
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       190
reason:      keyword "datepicker"
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DateTimeInput
description: DateTimeInput combines date and time selection in one field. With presentation="adaptive-native" (the default), mouse/trackpad devices use Astryx typed fields and popovers, while coarse-pointer devices use browser/OS date and time controls in the same two-segment field. presentation="native" uses both native controls on every pointer; presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet" keeps Astryx's own surfaces - pointer fields on fine pointers and the coordinated Date/Time bottom sheet on coarse pointers; "popover" and "bottom-sheet" force one Astryx surface on every pointer. The closed segments stay side by side when at least 400px is available and wrap into full-width rows below 400px, independent of viewport width. Use it for scheduling, event creation, deadline setting, or any form field that needs a specific datetime.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component DateTimeInput

name:        useCalendarDays
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      hook
score:       190
reason:      keyword "date picker"
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Builds the day grid for one month: every date to show, including the previous and next months' days that fill the first and last weeks, grouped into weeks, plus localized weekday header names that start on weekStartsOn. It is the layout Calendar uses, for a custom month view such as a compact availability grid or a mini calendar. It returns data only: rendering, selection, keyboard navigation and the grid's accessibility semantics are the caller's.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarDays

name:        ComplexSelector
package:     @astryxdesign/core
domain:      component
score:       98
reason:      matches 1/2 terms: picker
import:      @astryxdesign/core/ComplexSelector
description: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row. It is intentionally one component: ComplexSelector owns the field, trigger, popover, focus restore, and changeAction flow, while the content render prop owns the selector-specific accessible structure.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component ComplexSelector
